comment: Demo runs for FreeFlux add-object editing (ICCV 2025, wtybest/FreeFlux). n_steps=50 and derive_step=7 match paper defaults. Omit 'source_image' for generated-image mode; include it for real-image mode.

runs.name: cat_yarn_generated

runs.target_prompt: a cat sitting on a wooden floor with a ball of yarn

runs.target_prompt: a yellow dog sitting on grass with a ball
